COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
 
SPA No. 36 of 2022
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, ACJ.
Shri Narayan Singh Dhanik, J. 
Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Vinay Bhatt, learned counsel 
for the appellants. 
Ms. Monika Pant, learned counsel for the 
respondent. 
 Heard. 
 The application for condonation of delay 
is infructuous as the Stamp Reporter points 
out that in view of the order passed by the 
Hon’ble Supreme Court during the COVID 
pandemic, there is no delay in this Special 
Appeal. Accordingly, IA No. 02 of 2022 
stands disposed of as infructuous. 
 Also heard on Special Appeal. 
 Admit the appeal. 
Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties and on perusal of the order 
impugned, it is directed that the effect and 
operation of judgment and order dated 
29.12.2021, passed by learned Single Judge, 
in Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1945 of 2019, shall 
remain stayed till the next date of listing.  List the matter on 11.04.2022. 
Stay application (IA No. 01 of 2022) also 
stands disposed of. 
 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) (S.K. Mishra, ACJ.)
 
 25.02.2022 Negi
